items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: And he was on the job and I'd go in there like fellas doing set in, you know. Yes. Few numbers like that before playing the job with him, no.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with the bunk at any time out there? No, no, I wouldn't say play. Set in, you know, on a job, you know.

Yeah. Yeah. Sometime he was in Iberville, I think. Iberville, Iberville, whatever you call it. And he was on the job and I'd go in there like fellas doing set in, you know. Yes. Few numbers like that before playing the job with him, no.
Of all the trumpet players you've heard, the older men here from around New Orleans, who was your favorite? Rene.
